records.classification: Ordinary scene/entity candidate dispatch; calls only recovered sweeps, rotations and rigid inverse. Not CRT, compiler support, import thunk or independent shared tail; engine authorship unresolved.

dependencies: Real BHSweepQuery including both BSP trees, face clip, optional segment fallback
BHWorldHit candidate identities from existing bh_world_query_run; static world geometry transform/model
Actor binding explicitly supplies original registry geometry, world/local matrices, +48 movement and +114 flags; no guessed BHEntity opaque fields or registry definitions
Existing source local rotations and rigid inverse; double 1.5 at 00489260
contract: Empty list applies full requested translation/X/Y/Z; disabled single actor returns miss without moving
One candidate leaves requested movement/angles unchanged; static inverse computed from actual transform; actors require flag 2
Moving actor uses requested movement minus actor movement after adding actor movement to pose; hit contact displacement multiplied by 1.5; single miss additionally subtracts actor movement
Multiple candidates each start from original pose; successful hits scale requested movement/angles and accumulated fraction; retain last successful pose/contact and swap its candidate to first
All-miss multiple-candidate result is last attempted pose (including unchanged pose when last actor disabled)
limits: Typed explicit source bindings replace original mixed pointer array and registry/actor ABI; this does not recover full actor constructors or script installation
Finite PC53 rigid transform scope inherited from swept implementation; no byte-match or original runtime replay claim
Invalid/foreign source inputs report failure with caller pose/vectors/output/order retained rather than original unsafe access
